Game Overview

Car Care Repair DuDu Mechanic is a casual title where step into the role of a master mechanic tackling a range of car troubles. With intuitive controls, you'll mend everything from flat tires to malfunctioning motors. Transform clunkers into pristine machines and build your reputation as you strive to become a five-star automotive expert.
